mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 280 and FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%, the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day returns as investors price in rate hikes.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 280 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts below 1750 units signal weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 5-day returns as real estate sector weakness spreads to broader equity markets.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases where HOUST < 1750.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 102 indicates manufacturing sector slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 60-day returns as supply chain disruptions reduce corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where INDPRO < 102.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rate above 3.65% signals labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day returns as consumer spending weakens and recession risks increase.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases where UNRATE > 3.65%.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth revision above 20,000 billion dollars indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 20-day returns through elevated corporate profit expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances where GDPC1 > 20000.

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in real assets (RSAFS) below 650,000 million and housing starts (HOUST) below 1750 units signals broad-based consumer demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 5-day returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases where RSAFS < 650000 and HOUST < 1750.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 280), elevated price levels trigger market volatility and negative S&P 500 60-day returns as central banks accelerate rate hikes to curb inflation.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances during CPIAUCSL > 280 periods.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 20-day returns through reduced cost of capital and increased equity valuation multiples.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.
